## Release Notes

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Stream preview command instead of waiting for completion (#1176)

### 📚 Documentation

- Update benchmarks

### 🤖 CI

- Lock everything to make sure dependencies match (#1170)

### ⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

- Nitpicks after multithreading review (#1172)

## Install skim 5.7.0

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/skim-rs/skim/releases/download/v5.7.0/skim-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://github.com/skim-rs/skim/releases/download/v5.7.0/skim-installer.ps1 | iex"
```
